question: Should ClawHub adopt a 40-character skill display-name maximum with grandfathering for existing over-limit hosted and GitHub-backed rows?
rationale: The PR creates a new stored catalog policy and legacy upgrade behavior; automation should not choose the public limit or whether existing over-limit rows are grandfathered.

options.title: Adopt 40 with grandfathering
options.body: Accept the proposed limit and legacy policy after the sync exact-limit edge is fixed and real behavior proof is added.

options.title: Choose a different policy
options.body: Ask the contributor to adjust the constant, UI, backend, sync behavior, and tests to the maintainer-selected limit or migration behavior.

options.title: Pause the policy change
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers define the display-name maximum and legacy handling outside the implementation review.

recommendation.title: Adopt 40 with grandfathering
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed limit and legacy policy after the sync exact-limit edge is fixed and real behavior proof is added.
